title: Chromatic Relativism, Deep Copy provenance and dual-mode clipboard

scope.objective: Implement extension GY-CHR-001: relational OKLCH colour engine with grey-line polarity, bounded/redacted Deep Copy provenance bundles, and a capability-gated dual-mode clipboard.
exclusions: chromatic Goya-language surface syntax (parser arrives with the language frontend)

implementation_record.notes: OKLCH conversion (Ottosson OKLab) with chroma-bisection gamut mapping; polar relations flip with theme polarity while brand-locked hue/chroma are preserved; grey-line guard L' = Lg - p(L-Lg) with GREY_LINE=0.6; WCAG contrast enforced on composited pairs by deterministic two-direction lightness search; Deep Copy bundles bounded, secret-redacted (email/bearer/api-token/long-hex) and consent-flag aware; clipboard capability model separates Verbatim from DeepContext grants. Post-review hardening: mutex poison recovery in goya-state (no panic paths), graceful error exit in goya-hello, SPDX license files (MIT + Apache-2.0) and lwoodz.toml added.

results.unit_tests: 43 passed, 0 failed workspace-wide (chroma:13, provenance:15, clipboard:4, foundation:11)
results.known_environment_defect: doctests still excluded: rustdoc cannot load libLLVM.so on this host

notable_findings.oklab_contrast: An OKLab L=0.5 grey composites to ~#636363 (relative luminance 0.125): pure white reaches only 6.01:1 against it, so grey-on-grey AAA is genuinely unsatisfiable. The resolver reports ContrastUnreachable rather than faking compliance — this behaviour is unit-tested as the required contract.
notable_findings.polarity_vs_complement: Unit tests assert dark/light surfaces differ while hue is preserved to within 1°, proving polarity is a lightness-relationship reflection, not an RGB complement.

risk_assessment.glyph_contrast_interaction: Contrast is enforced on composited sRGB pairs, including opacity-bearing borders only via their opaque sRGB cache; translucent compositing over arbitrary backdrops arrives with the renderer (Wave 3) and must re-check pairs.
risk_assessment.redaction: Pattern-based and conservative; a dedicated secret-scanner pass by the assurance swarm remains advisable before Deep Copy ships.
risk_assessment.shortcut_collision: Ctrl+Shift+C collision with terminals acknowledged; remapping contract recorded in GY-CLIPBOARD/1, enforced when input hotkeys land.
